Here’s a simple, tasty weeknight stir‑fry:  
**Ingredients:** 1 lb chicken breast (thinly sliced), 2 cups mixed veggies (broccoli, bell pepper, snap peas), 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp ginger (grated), 1 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water, cooked rice or noodles, salt & pepper.  
**Method:** Toss chicken with cornstarch mix; sauté in hot pan 3‑4 min until browned, remove. Stir‑fry garlic & ginger 30 s, add veggies 2‑3 min, return chicken, pour sauces, cook 2 min until glossy. Serve over rice/noodles.
